sourceEvidence.label: Research output source and offline synthetic evidence

assessment.summary: Lossy diagnostic filtering is reused as research-data policy; a shared contextual output boundary is proposed, not implemented.

nonNegotiables: No production data/config/token access or provider calls
No merge, push, restart or maintenance
Preserve selected auth and known-secret protections
Four-channel canonical data equality, not identical SDK envelopes
No broad regex relaxation or per-subsystem bypass proliferation
assumptions: No CPU/RSS/stream-latency benchmarks have been measured
The current user message is not approval of the SEC-local exemption

opportunities.title: Own Research output policy by type and destination
opportunities.summary: Separate admitted public research data/prose from lossy diagnostics.
opportunities.diagnosis: Transport-specific serializers reused a probe safety net as an incompatible data integrity and secrecy policy.

evidence.claim: A deliberately over-redacting diagnostic safety net uses generic opaque-string rules.
Tool results, answer deltas and final answers share generic redaction; Claude uses exact-only prose replacement.
API-key runtime errors have captured-key and generic redaction despite no redact call in tool serializers.
Capture IDs are prefixed and cursors have canonical, request-bound semantics; facts.py stores finite Decimal via str.
Eight selected real adapter cases: four API-key passes, four OAuth assertion failures, no setup errors.
Synthetic exact-function probes corrupt public text and show split-token replacement limitations; not a production disclosure.
Input-only registry and channel-specific result handling lack one accountable output-policy boundary.

desiredInvariants: Credentials remain in ephemeral auth-owned state
Registered complete result policies are revalidated at emission
Canonical safe payloads remain equal across four transports
Known secrets and invalid structures fail closed without corrupted identifiers
Public prose is not filtered solely by length or entropy
Streaming protection holds across fragment boundaries
Modified quotes never claim exact source bytes
